human_notes: Fix only rejects dimension name "method", not the other sel keyword arguments covered by the requirement. Revised tests only exercise method; duplicate pytest import is unnecessary.
Unconditional False for ProductSet versus FiniteSet contradicts ordinary set-subset semantics, even where the finite set contains all tuples.
Returning [] from find_ordering_name() drops the parent-link ordering entirely rather than explicitly ordering by the parent primary key.
Added fill_value documentation says it is used for constant strategy, contradicting the update that it must be ignored; fix leaves an empty line in SimpleImputer invocation.
Classifying every non-None filepath as a FITS file disregards file type entirely and is implausible for an is_fits detector.
Code checks all fields with remote_field.model, not just ForeignKey subclasses, and no longer removes the "to" parameter for valid relations. This changes unrelated migration detection.
Patch warns and ignores min_count for any sized axis, including one-element sequences, although requirement specifies length > 1. Also duplicates null-mask handling for single-axis reduction.
